findings.title: Semantically malformed JSONL can throw instead of returning OperationResult failure

probe.command: dotnet run Quality02EvalOnlyRunner with temporary JSONL containing layer_inputs:null

findings.why_it_matters: Malformed input should be an OperationResult validation failure. Deserialized null collection properties are expected input-shape errors, not exceptional crash paths.
findings.required_fix: Validate deserialized collection properties before Count, Select, or Concat use; return validation errors for null layer_inputs, row failure_codes, layer evidence_refs, and layer failure_codes; add targeted no-report tests.

findings.title: Raw private text can leak through failure_codes while raw_private_text_copied=false

probe.command: dotnet run Quality02EvalOnlyRunner with temporary JSONL containing failure_codes:[<sentinel-redacted>]
probe.evidence: Command exited 0 and emitted the sentinel in report JSON, score JSONL, and human_reviewer_note.

findings.why_it_matters: No raw private text may be copied into shared artifacts. Current tests cover raw private input refs and some copied fields but miss failure_codes, which are emitted and folded into notes.
findings.required_fix: Validate row-level and layer-level failure_codes with the same raw-private marker gate, and preferably all emitted input-derived string fields; add sentinel tests for both failure-code paths and assert generated artifacts contain no sentinel before RawPrivateTextCopied=false is accepted.
